intent: Refine sensor positions by moving the front-center sensor slightly forward to y=0.065 m and shifting the left and right outer sensors slightly forward to y=0.045 m to improve forward line sensing and balance lateral coverage. Maintain sensor size at 0.016 m and wheel track at 0.14 m for stability. Expect sustained zero line loss, improved anticipation of line curvature, and reduced steering oscillation for smoother control.
rationale: The previous iteration's refined sensor layout with a slightly forward front-center sensor at y=0.065 m, larger sensor size (0.016 m), and wider wheel track (0.14 m) yielded excellent race results with zero line loss on the s-bend and only one line loss event on the oval track, along with low steering oscillation and error. Integration feedback suggests that moving the front-center sensor slightly further forward and adjusting the lateral sensors slightly forward could improve forward line sensing and control smoothness, potentially reducing steering oscillation and line loss events further. The body dimensions, wheel radius, and mass remain unchanged to maintain stable dynamics. I expect these small positional refinements to enhance the robot's anticipation of line curvature and balance sensor coverage, leading to sustained or improved completion rates and smoother control. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, max_error, and steering_oscillation to evaluate the impact of these geometry adjustments on line following performance and control stability.
